about_the_game:
You can test and customize some weapons in an interactive Armory and try them on enemies in a procedurally generated level.

This is a in-development demo of ProtonVR, bugs and QoL issues are to be expected and mitigated with your help.

The goal of this demo is to gather as much community feedback as possible to make this game as best as it can be and give you all the much deserve fun you all want.

Try it out, join the Discord (see the links) and feel free to reach out!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • VR Support: SteamVR (Meta Headsets and Valve Only)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Test and customize some weapons in an interactive Armory and try them by shooting enemy cyborgs in a procedurally generated level in this short alpha demo of ProtonVR: The next retro-gen roguelike VR!
